title: AI-generated videos to maximally drive a target brain region
summary: NEVO is a research project from EPFL that uses AI-generated videos specifically designed to maximally stimulate targeted brain regions, combining generative AI with neuroscience research to create optimized visual stimuli for brain study and potential therapeutic applications.
problem_solved: Creates optimized AI-generated visual stimuli to selectively activate specific brain regions for neuroscience research and potential therapeutic interventions
why_valuable: Enables precise brain stimulation research and could lead to new treatments for neurological conditions through AI-optimized sensory inputs
